rationale: Cluster [validate_failed::rule-cheat-sheet] / t02-chinese-alias: the cheat sheet silently omits E4 (alias targets must exist; alias-id collisions are forbidden; {id,context} disambiguation). For Chinese-name crawls, E4 is the dominant failure mode — without it in the table, a user staring at a Chinese-alias validate failure cannot tell which universal rule to consult. The note 'rule coverage or cheat-sheet clarity may be the issue' points directly here.
expected_effect: Users debugging Chinese-alias validation failures (and Pattern-B authors in general) see E4 listed and a Pattern-B reminder immediately adjacent to the cheat-sheet table, so the alias-target / alias-collision / context-form rules are no longer hidden in the deep references. Reduces the chance of an alias-table that looks valid (E1-E15 all green) but is semantically incomplete.
regression_risk: Additive only — no existing row removed, no rule semantics changed. The Pattern-B reminder explicitly notes that 0-warning validation does not prove alias completeness, which is honest and does not over-promise validator coverage.
